title: Progress display for the photo upload (test fixture)
question: How should the page show that 3 of 8 photos have uploaded?

recommended.reason: the count in words is the only one that needs no decoding.

options.name: A sentence
options.note: States the count in words and names the file in progress; no graphic at all.

options.name: A bar
options.note: One bar filled in proportion, with the count beside it; familiar and compact.

options.name: Eight steps
options.note: One block per photo, filled as each arrives; shows the total at a glance.
